shared: Corvid crime families borrow now, carry Debt with interest, and turn paying it off into permanent buffs.
differ: What debt is: bills your kills pay, interest that feeds stats, or a lock on Tier up.

takes.label: Kills pay the bill
takes.line: Debt repays itself from your gold each turn, and units that kill pay it off mid-fight; each repayment, however big, triggers buffs.
takes.look_if: fights where kills pay your bills and buff the flock.

takes.label: Interest feeds the ravens
takes.line: Every gold of interest you pay grows your units, so you run a tab; you can pawn a unit, then replay it.
takes.look_if: a running tab and units you pawn now and replay later.

takes.label: Debt locks Tier up
takes.line: While you owe you can't Tier up, interest compounds, losing costs extra hero damage, and a capstone wants exactly 7 Debt.
takes.look_if: tempo gambles against a tier lock, and exact-number puzzles.
